name: Miyama Yukiko
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c4078]Reiji's[/url] late lover.   

The name Yukiko means "reason, case, cause" (由) (yu), "chronicle" (紀) (ki) and "child" (子) (ko).
Yukiko's surname Miyama means "deep" (深) (mi) and "mountain, hill" (山) (yama).

[Etymology from the [url=https://kara-no-shoujo.fandom.com/wiki/Yukiko_Miyama]Wiki[/url]]
